PullRequest.Title: Use one endpoint for the common.tid telemetry property
PullRequest.Body:
`msftTelemetrySender.ts` declares the `common.tid` common property twice:
- `sendTelemetryEvent` uses endpoint `GoogleAnalyticsId`.
- `sendTelemetryErrorEvent` uses `GoogleAnalyticsID`.

The GDPR tooling compares endpoints case-sensitively, and the telemetry extractor kept whichever declaration it found first. `@vscode/telemetry-extractor` 2.0 (microsoft/vscode-telemetry-extractor#84) reports conflicting common property declarations.

This change uses `GoogleAnalyticsId` in both places. That's the value the GDPR catalog already has, and the catalog API doesn't accept changes to common properties. It's a comment-only change.
